title: Easy to build — Perfect Circles & Shapes in Minecraft Bedrock
topic: Minecraft Bedrock mein perfect circle, hollow shape ya doosra custom structure banana hai?
description: Minecraft Bedrock mein perfect circle, hollow shape ya doosra custom structure banana hai? Is tutorial mein shape ko manually block-by-block design karne ke bajaye Shape Generator se dimensions aur block type choose karna, phir generated .mcstructure file ko HoloPrint ke through Minecraft mein hologram-style building guide ki tarah use karna cover kiya gaya hai. Yeh approach symmetric builds aur planned structures ke liye useful ho sakti hai.
